subject.title: Long Beach Community College District Board, Area 5

text: As an experienced education leader, United States Air Force veteran, son of Vietnamese refugees, and Long Beach homeowner, I know education changes lives. I am running for the Long Beach Community College District Board of Trustees, Area 5, to expand opportunities for every student, strengthen workforce training, and protect taxpayers' investments.

For more than 15 years, I have served students and families in the Los Angeles Unified School District. As a School District Administrator, I oversee programs serving thousands of students while managing multi-million-dollar budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring efficient operations. Every day, I make responsible decisions that improve services, maximize resources, and put students first.

I proudly served in the U.S. Air Force as a Staff Sergeant, completing two tours of duty in Turkey and Afghanistan. I went back to school to earn a Bachelor of Science degree from Cal Poly Pomona, a Master's Degree from Bowie State University, and an MBA in Finance from California State University, Long Beach. As an experienced educator, veteran, and Long Beach City College parent, I will bring independent leadership, fiscal accountability, transparency, and educational experience to prepare students for 21st-century careers.

I am honored to have earned endorsements from the LBCC Faculty Association, VoteVets, United Steelworkers, Teamsters, LBCC Board President Uduak-Joe Ntuk, Vice President Dr. Ennette Morton, and many respected neighborhood, small-business, labor, and community leaders.
I respectfully ask for your vote. Learn more at www.votenguyen4lbcc.com

strong: Education has been the foundation of my career and my commitment to public service.

text: As former President of the Long Beach Council PTA, a higher education leader, public commissioner, and small business owner, I have spent more than 20 years building partnerships that strengthen education, expand opportunity, and serve our community.

I am running for the Long Beach Community College District Board of Trustees Area 5 because I believe Long Beach City College changes lives. A strong community college prepares students for university transfer, workforce training, and meaningful careers while strengthening our local economy.

As your Trustee, I will provide thoughtful, collaborative leadership focused on three priorities: student success, fiscal transparency, and community engagement. I will work to ensure every decision puts students first, protects taxpayers' investment, and strengthens collaboration with local schools, employers, labor, and community organizations.

I am proud to have earned the support of a strong coalition of leaders including outgoing Trustee Dr. Virginia Baxter, Congressman Robert Garcia, Assemblymember Josh Lowenthal and Jose L Solache, and dozens more.

I have dedicated my career to bringing people together, solving problems, and serving our community with integrity. I would be honored to earn your vote on November 3rd. You can learn more about my campaign at joinsusana.com
